$comment: The app's E2E facts, read by scripts/e2e/ (the runner and the screenshot capture) and by the e2e-maestro skill's checkers. productionAppIds and network are required; the schema says what every other key does and its default. Filled for this harness: it has no API (privacy profile api-port with no host yet) and its test builds install the network guard, so the runtime proof is offline-only; buildExtra keeps ads off because react-native-google-mobile-ads is installed.

extraTestIDs.debug.menu: The debug menu's root (debug-menu-and-test-hooks; test builds only).
extraTestIDs.debug.setup-error: Shown when the app refuses a debug link (debug-menu-and-test-hooks); the setup sub-flow asserts it is absent.
